name: netlogo-intellisense
description: Autocomplete, documentation, navigation and compile diagnostics for NetLogo (.nlogo, .nlogox, .nls) files

netlogo.diagnostics.enabled.description: Run fast in-editor checks (bracket balance, duplicate procedures) as you type.

netlogo.diagnostics.undefinedNames.description: Warn about identifiers that are not defined anywhere the file can see. Turn this off if breed- or extension-generated names produce false warnings.

netlogo.compile.enabled.description: Use the real NetLogo compiler to check the model.

netlogo.compile.onSave.description: Run the NetLogo compiler when a NetLogo file is saved.

netlogo.compile.netLogoDirectory.description: Path to the NetLogo installation directory. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

netlogo.compile.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the NetLogo compiler before giving up.
